diagnostic_history: The first source draft reused scratch[0] for each copied output row and differed at owner offset 0x20. Native advances a single scratch read cursor across rows; the candidate now advances it likewise.

The initial candidate stopped before the 32-entry flush. The candidate now calls the real dispatch_engine_2c630 wrapper, real dispatch_local_050d0 consumer, and real dispatch_engine_2c630 wrapper again, then resumes from the consumer-cleared queue. The first differential showed that native resumes at coordinate index 0 with pending=1; the previous stack-local reading incorrectly predicted index 32. A two-record fixture also crosses the flush after creating a predecessor chain and confirms the first returned key and successor rows remain consistent.
limits: Covers one four-byte record, flags 0x40, and stream [1,0xa5,2] for record codes 0,2,4,6; a one-record queue-boundary case drains an existing 32-item batch, and a two-record chain case fills the 32nd slot then flushes before appending the next record.

Seeds the measured post-0x39b0 reserved masks at groups 0,16,4,1; reuses calibration/resource_data.c link rows/map, dispatch_storage.c coordinates/pending, level_storage.c cursor, and the private audited 0x5e138/0x6e660 data provider.

The flush case links existing frame_commands.c::dispatch_local_050d0, dispatcher_bridges.c::dispatch_engine_2c630, and host_wrappers.c::dispatch_engine_2c7f0. Controlled native/source host spies compare exact callback order, rectangle words, owner offsets, and flushed-byte hashes.

The captured payload is the verified 128-byte first-game stack prefix from call return RVA 0x6506, count 1, flags 0x40. Its private bytes are kept under work/; the report records the prefix hash and call provenance without embedding the payload.
Scratch streams beyond the measured 0x400 prefix remain incomplete. The captured native pointer and caller stack state are not treated as a complete live global-state snapshot.
confidence: Finite native-x86 cases, no FUNCTION_MATCH or fully captured live-global-state proof.
